title: Exploitation for client execution (browser/app)
hypothesis: A client-side exploit (browser, PDF, office) executed on a workstation.
queries: DeviceProcessEvents | where FileName in ('acrord32.exe','chrome.exe','msedge.exe') | where ProcessCommandLine contains 'rundll32' or ProcessCommandLine contains 'powershell'
rationale: Client apps spawning shells = exploit chain.
